record.question: Fixing limit of lands to be owned by an individual is
record.explanation: Answer A: Land ceiling. A land ceiling law fixes the maximum landholding an individual or family may own. Reference: https://landreforms.dolr.gov.in/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
